name: SEC Filing Fee Calculator
tagline: A local-first SEC filing fee worksheet with memo and CSV export
description: SEC Filing Fee Calculator is a free, open-source, local-first web tool for estimating SEC registration and transaction filing fees from the current FY2026 rate. It runs entirely in the browser, requires no signup, and provides copyable memo text plus an EX-FILING-FEES review row.

features.title: SEC Fee Estimate
features.description: Calculates filing fees from aggregate amount or shares times price

features.title: FY2026 Rate
features.description: Uses the current SEC rate of 0.00013810 for the active fee year

features.title: Memo Export
features.description: Copies a filing-fee review memo for internal notes

features.title: CSV Review Row
features.description: Copies an EX-FILING-FEES review row for spreadsheet checks

features.title: No Tracking
features.description: Runs without analytics, cookies, beacons, storage, uploads, or external scripts
